newsitem.title: USA: GM mulls shedding of Hughes unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: GM mulls shedding of Hughes unit - WSJ.

text.p: General Motors Corp has indicated to investors that it is considering breaking up and selling its Hughes Electronics Corp subsidiary, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The newspaper said GM Vice Chairman Harry Pearce told an investors' dinner earlier this year "to expect news" after the conclusion of contract talks with the United Auto Workers union.
GM Chairman John F. Smith Jr, at a separate dinner, told attendees General Motors probably would not own either Hughes, or GM's Deplhi Automotive Systems unit, within five years.
The Journal reported that top GM executives have said at recent meetings of analysts and investors that the question is not whether to sell the unit but when and how.
